# @streetjs/cache

> 标签: cache, esm, eviction, in-memory, lru, street-framework, streetjs, ttl, typescript, zero-dependencies

## 简介

StreetJS in-memory cache foundation: a bounded LRU cache with per-entry TTL, periodic sweep of expired entries, and O(1) get/set/delete. Zero runtime dependencies.
